prompt: Read the gene-by-sample count matrix from `inputs/counts.tsv`, compute `log2(count + 1)`, and calculate the gene-gene Pearson correlation matrix. Define undirected associations by absolute correlation greater than 0.7, excluding self-links. For each gene, report its number of associations and its mean absolute correlation across the full correlation row as columns `gene`, `degree`, and `mean_correlation` in `outputs/ppi_stats.csv`.
